nodes.label: Orange rounded-square app icon with cream bee, ring, and star
nodes.rationale: Rounded-square app icon. The ground is a diagonal gradient from deep red at the top-left to bright orange at the bottom and right, crossed by a lighter glossy band through the upper right. Centered is a pale cream-yellow mark: two short curved antennae, a domed head, a horizontal elliptical ring, a four-pointed star at the middle, and a rounded lower body. No letters or readable wordmark.
